statement: Extend the L4 flat-model Jacobi/Rauch bridge to the D10 constant-curvature model jacobiSol K (K >= 0): direct Euclidean-normalization bound |j_K'/j_K - 1/t| <= C on (0,t0), fed to riccati_le_of_singular_normalization to obtain the classical Rauch I comparison u'/u <= j_K'/j_K when k >= K, with a non-vacuous spherical witness and axiom audit.

summary.headline_theorem: rauch_upper_of_constCurv_jacobi: for a scalar Jacobi solution u with u 0 = 0, u' 0 = 1, |u''| <= B on (0,T), B t0 <= 1/2, k >= K >= 0, K t0^2 <= 1, K = 0 or sqrt(K) T < pi, and u > 0 on (0,T], one has u'(t)/u(t) <= j_K'(t)/j_K(t) on (0,T).
summary.model_normalization: jacobiSol_logDeriv_bound: 0 <= K -> 0 < t -> K t^2 <= 1 -> |jacobiDeriv K t / jacobiSol K t - 1/t| <= K t; packaged as jacobiSol_logDeriv_normalized: EuclideanNormalizedOn (j_K'/j_K) 1 (K t0) t0.
summary.engine_feed: rauch_upper_of_constCurv applies Poincare.D12.ComparisonGeodesics.riccati_le_of_singular_normalization with kbar = K, mbar = j_K'/j_K, dmbar = (j_K'' j_K - (j_K')^2)/j_K^2, C = max Cu (K t0), using jacobiSol_riccati_identity for the model equality and jacobi_riccati_identity for the u-side inequality.
summary.flat_recovery: rauch_upper_flat_of_jacobi: K = 0 specialization recovers u'/u <= 1/t (j_0(t) = t, j_0'(t) = 1).
summary.witness: spherical_rauch_witness / spherical_rauch_witness_cot: k = 4 vs K = 1, T = 1/2, t0 = 1/4, B = 2 gives 2 cot(2t) <= cot t on (0,1/2), strict (gap 0.100335 at t=0.1, 0.533388 at t=0.49); the threshold B t0 = 1/2 is saturated, so the instance exercises the engine end-to-end.
